details:
* SECURITY UPDATE: CPU exhaustion via unbounded hash_search() chain walk
     - debian/patches/CVE-2026-70453.patch: cap the same-weak-checksum chain
       walk at MAX_CHAIN_LEN (1024) in hash_search()
     - CVE-2026-70453
   * SECURITY UPDATE: out-of-bounds F_SUM read/write from malicious peer input
     - debian/patches/CVE-2026-70458.patch: validate peer-supplied protocol
       input in recv_file_entry(), read_args() and read_sum_head(); guard the
       F_SUM checksum slot in hard_link_check() and log_formatted()
     - CVE-2026-70458
   * SECURITY UPDATE: signed integer overflow via peer-supplied MSG_IO_TIMEOUT
     - debian/patches/CVE-2026-70462.patch: reject non-positive and cap
       over-large MSG_IO_TIMEOUT values at 86400 in read_a_msg()
     - debian/patches/CVE-2026-70462-2.patch: make set_io_timeout()
       overflow-safe and read a negative --timeout as none
     - CVE-2026-70462
   * SECURITY UPDATE: daemon slot exhaustion via stalled pre-transfer handshake
     - debian/patches/CVE-2026-70464.patch: bound the daemon handshake with an
       absolute deadline in start_daemon() enforced in safe_read()
     - CVE-2026-70464
   * SECURITY UPDATE: directory creation escapes the destination
     - debian/patches/CVE-2026-53785.patch: create the receiver's
       directories (make_path() and recv_generator()) with mkdirat() on a
       parent walked with O_NOFOLLOW, following only symlinks that stay in
       the destination; --keep-dirlinks still follows any directory symlink
       except on a push's server receiver
     - CVE-2026-53785
   * SECURITY UPDATE: rrsync restricted-directory escape
     - debian/patches/CVE-2026-53783.patch: replace the Perl rrsync with
       upstream's hardened Python one and add the --drop-D option it passes
     - debian/control: add python3 to Build-Depends for the new test
     - CVE-2026-53783
   * SECURITY UPDATE: command injection via daemon hooks and connect hosts
     - debian/patches/CVE-2026-53790.patch: escape %RSYNC_*% values in the
       xfer exec hooks and refuse shell-active ones, reject unsafe
       RSYNC_CONNECT_PROG hosts, escape newlines in safe_arg()
     - CVE-2026-53790
